meta.title: Backups
meta.description: Scheduled backups of the DeepSeek Harness configuration, with a sidebar history.
title: Config backups
subtitle: Periodically archives the essential ~/.dsh configuration and notifies you when it is done.
enabled.onDetail: Every {hours} hours, keeping the latest {keep} snapshots.
enabled.offDetail: Enable the plugin to start backing up automatically.
history.empty: No backups yet. Use "Back up now" for the first one.
status.denied: This page may not call the backup service (needs the owner session).
notification.title: dsh config backed up
error.title: Latest failure
service.offline: Backup service unavailable (plugin may have been unloaded)
export.hint: Press Export on a backup to pack it into a .tar.gz; import it elsewhere with Choose file.
import.hint: An import only adds a row; press Restore to apply it.
restore.hint: Restore overwrites the current configuration, after taking a safety backup first.
